subject: Capacity & MAP: BrazenBio pilot runway and acceptance timeline
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@brazenbio.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Hart <tom.hart@brazenbio.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial ask — pilot sizing & MAP for private deployment

Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at BrazenBio is excited about Redwood's low-latency inference and the private deployment story. We're kicking off internal due diligence for a Q3 pilot and we need to line up a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that covers: capacity runway, environment lead-times (Dedicated vs Private), acceptance criteria, and key procurement milestones so we can get internal approval.

Top-line asks from our side:
- Rough GPU pool sizing recommendation for a 6-week pilot (target: 200k tokens/day in peak).
- Typical lead times to stand up Dedicated reserved capacity vs Private (VPC + on-prem) for a POC.
- List of required security evidence + contacts to accelerate SOC2 / network review.

I'm attaching a short requirements doc with our pilot goals. Can you put together a draft MAP + a recommended staging approach (e.g., Dedicated first, cutover to Private)? We're aiming to present to purchasing on May 5.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Head of AI Ops, BrazenBio
Samantha Lee
Attachment: Brazen_pilot_requirements.pdf (PDF, 320KB)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@brazenbio.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — pilot sizing & MAP for private deployment

Samantha —

Appreciate the goals and the requirements PDF. Quick summary up front: we recommend a staged MAP — reserve a Dedicated GPU pool to run the pilot (fastest path), and cut over to Private (VPC + customer-managed on-prem or colocation) for production once infra & security approvals are complete. Below is a draft MAP and our sizing/leadtime guidance. I'll attach a starter MAP spreadsheet for you to iterate.

1) Pilot GPU sizing (recommended)
- Pilot target: handle 200k tokens/day peak with 95th percentile latency < 200ms.
- Recommended starting pool: 4 x NVIDIA H100 nodes (shared across jobs with autoscaling up to 6 nodes during peak). Equivalent fallback: 8 x A100-80GB if H100 procurement / reservation is constrained.
- Batching / KV cache config: enable continuous batching with a 50ms batching window + prefix cache for common prompts (estimated 20-30% token cost reduction).

2) Lead times (typical)
- Hosted/API: immediate (days) — good for initial model eval, not for PII/regulatory data.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): 3–5 weeks to reserve and provision a dedicated pool if capacity available; add 1–2 weeks for SLA/legal paperwork if vendor procurement required.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): 8–12 weeks from mutual acceptance to go-live for typical enterprise on-prem installs (includes network onboarding, KMS integration, and SOC2 evidence exchange).

3) Acceptance criteria (pilot)
- Throughput: sustain 200k tokens/day for 7 consecutive business days
- Latency: 95p < 200ms for gen endpoints during load test
- Quality: model outputs pass Brazen verification set (A/B with baseline) with <5% regression on core prompts
- Security: complete SOC2 self-attestation + network allowlisting test

4) Draft MAP (milestones & owners)
- Week 0 (this week): Confirm scope and sign mutual MAP — Owner: Brazen (Samantha) / Redwood (Jonas) — target 2027-04-18
- Week 1–2: Provision Dedicated pool & run smoke tests — Owner: Redwood (Karthik) — target provision by 2027-05-02
- Week 2–6: Pilot execution & acceptance tests — Owner: Brazen (Tom) / Redwood (infra) — acceptance test window 2027-05-03 to 2027-05-21
- Week 6–12: Private onboarding parallel path (network, KMS) — Owner: Brazen (IT) / Redwood (security & infra) — tentative cutover by 2027-06-30

Attachments: Brazen_MAP_v0.1.xlsx (draft MAP workbook) — I put estimated dates in the sheet and a short risk/contingency section.

Next steps:
- I'll schedule a short 30-min MAP alignment call for Friday; can you confirm availability?
- Grace, please add the SOC2 checklist + quick copy of our standard DPA into the shared Drive folder so Brazen's procurement can review.

Happy to adjust sizing if your internal load profile looks different.

—Jonas
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Brazen_MAP_v0.1.xlsx (XLSX, 48KB)

From: Samantha Lee <samantha@brazenbio.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Hart <tom.hart@brazenbio.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — pilot sizing & MAP for private deployment

Thanks Jonas — that is helpful. A couple of clarifications before the call:

1) Acceptance tests: can you share an example acceptance test script (load profile + pass/fail thresholds) we can use to align our QA?
2) Staging approach: would we be able to start the pilot on Dedicated and run it for the full acceptance window while Private onboarding completes in parallel? Any impact on migration or KV cache state?
3) Security evidence: I've attached our vendor diligence questionnaire — we'll need the SOC2 report and a short network architecture diagram showing how Redwood's Private deployment will sit in our VPC.

If we can get the MAP + acceptance script by end of day tomorrow we can present to purchasing on May 5.

Appreciate it —
Samantha
Attachment: Brazen_pilot_requirements.pdf (uploaded earlier)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@brazenbio.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 11:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — pilot sizing & MAP for private deployment

Samantha — quick answers inline: \n
1) Acceptance script: attached is a lightweight acceptance_criteria.docx with a sample load-run (50k concurrent tokens over 30m windows) and pass/fail thresholds. We'll also include a JMeter/Locust template in Drive.

2) Staged approach: yes — start on Dedicated and run full acceptance while Private onboarding occurs. For KV cache: we recommend a cache-warm strategy during cutover (snapshot prefix keys and seed with a short warm-up run) — migration impact is low if the model versions remain pinned. We can handle warm-up tooling as part of the MAP tasks.

3) Security evidence: Grace will share SOC2 summary and the network diagram template by EOD. For the Private deployment we'll need a small allowlist window and an account of required egress rules.

Call: I'm proposing Friday 2027-04-16 at 10:00 PT — invite incoming.

—Jonas
Attachment: acceptance_criteria.docx (DOCX, 12KB)
